chunks: The ghusl (ritual bath) of Friday is a purification and an expiation for the sins between the two, from one Friday to the next Friday.

key_terms.الذُّنُوبِ: sins committed during the period mentioned
key_terms.طَهُورٌ: a means of purification and cleansing
key_terms.غُسْلُ: ghusl (ritual bath), specifically the recommended bath associated with Friday
key_terms.كَفَّارَةٌ: an expiation that wipes away sins
key_terms.مِنَ الْجُمُعَةِ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ: from one Friday to the next Friday
key_terms.يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ: the day of Friday, the weekly sacred congregational day

ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of ghusl (ritual bath) on Friday in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the ghusl (ritual bath) of Friday serves as a means of taharah (ritual purity) and expiation. It emphasizes the spiritual and devotional merit of observing Friday ghusl as an act connected to forgiveness between one Friday and the next.
